clue.text: Wearing a hairpiece to add excitement

parts.note: a switch is a tress of false hair added to one's own
clothes you are wearing are said to be on

explanation.surface: Someone livens up their look by donning a wig.
explanation.definitionFit: To switch on a crowd is to turn it on, stirring up enthusiasm and thrill.

clue.text: A battle later settled in court

indicators.note: the shuffled letters go inside the word for court

parts.note: to court a lover is to woo them

indicators.note: settled suggests letters being rearranged until they settle into a new order

explanation.surface: A dispute between parties is later resolved in the courtroom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'court' is a verb here, to woo, not a law court; 'settled' is the anagram signal and 'in' the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon's final defeat in 1815 took place near the Belgian village of that name.

clue.text: Are yet to form revised EC agreement

indicators.note: a revised text has been reworked, so the letters of the phrase are rearranged

explanation.surface: A draft European treaty still needs reworking before it is final.
explanation.walkthrough: 'revised' rearranges the twelve letters of ARE YET TO FORM.
explanation.definitionFit: The 1957 pact founding the European Economic Community, the EC, was signed in Italy's capital.

clue.text: Housework left to go to a game

parts.note: HO is a common abbreviation for house
OP, short for opus, is a work in music

explanation.surface: Someone abandons the chores to go off and play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Housework' looks like chores but splits into two abbreviations, one after the other.
explanation.definitionFit: A fairground stall where players throw rings over prizes to win them.

clue.text: Observe that the subtonic was omitted

parts.note: if something was omitted there is none of it, so no
te is the seventh, or subtonic

explanation.surface: A music examiner remarks that the seventh degree of the scale was left out.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'the subtonic was omitted' as a phrase: no te.
explanation.definitionFit: To note something is to notice or remark on it.

clue.text: A parish priest relaxed and satisfied

parts.note: pain that has relaxed has eased

explanation.surface: A local clergyman settles down feeling content.
explanation.definitionFit: Appeased means placated, with demands met and anger soothed.

clue.text: Situated between small island and the south of France

parts.note: mid means in the middle, between two things
I is an abbreviation for island

explanation.surface: Someone describes a place lying between an islet and the French Riviera.
explanation.definitionFit: Le Midi is the French name for the southern part of France.

clue.text: Have to settle fashionable socialite in punt

indicators.note: the two pieces go inside the word for punt

parts.note: a punt is a gamble, a bet
something fashionable is in
a deb, short for debutante, is a young society woman

explanation.surface: A trendy young society girl has a flutter and must pay up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'punt' here is a bet, not a flat-bottomed boat.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who owes money has accounts still to pay off.

clue.text: Work by post office location over the road

parts.note: OP, short for opus, is a work
a site is a location

explanation.surface: Someone describes a job near the post office, just across the street.
explanation.definitionFit: Facing, across the street, is where the house opposite stands.

clue.text: Visual handicap appearing in the middle of last year

indicators.note: the answer shows up embedded within the words that follow

explanation.surface: An eye problem cropped up halfway through last year.
explanation.definitionFit: A painful swelling on the eyelid that hampers sight.

clue.text: Fear of arrest

definitions.meaning: a sense of dread or anxiety about what is to come
the capture of a suspect by police

explanation.definitionFit: The one word covers both anxious dread and the seizing of a criminal.

clue.text: Publicise a foreign banquet

parts.note: a spread is a lavish meal laid out
abroad means in or of foreign parts

explanation.surface: A promoter advertises an exotic feast.
explanation.definitionFit: To broadcast news widely is to make it known far and wide.

clue.text: To be honest, it's a quiet song with a loud melody

parts.note: P, piano, is the musical mark for quiet
a lay is a song or ballad
F, forte, is the musical mark for loud
an air is a tune

explanation.surface: Frankly, the piece pairs a soft ballad with a brash tune.
explanation.definitionFit: Playing by the rules, without cheating, is acting honestly.

clue.text: About noon we returned to start afresh

parts.note: re means about or concerning

indicators.note: returned means the word is turned back and read in reverse

explanation.surface: Around midday we came back to begin again.
explanation.definitionFit: To renew is to begin again or restore something to freshness.

clue.text: Stern oarsman has apoplexy

definitions.meaning: the rower nearest the stern who sets the pace for the crew
a sudden seizure caused by a burst or blocked blood vessel in the brain

explanation.definitionFit: The same word names the pace-setting rower and a brain seizure.

clue.text: Shed is reduced by five hundred

parts.note: D is the Roman numeral for 500
goods reduced in price are marked off

explanation.surface: A garden building's price is cut by five hundred.
explanation.definitionFit: To take off a hat or garment is to remove it.

clue.text: In retirement Edward longed to be free of ties

indicators.note: retiring is drawing back, so the name is read backwards

parts.note: Ted is a short form of Edward
to have ached for something is to have longed for it

explanation.surface: A retired Edward yearned to be unattached.
explanation.definitionFit: A house standing alone, not joined to its neighbours, is unattached.

clue.text: Had to be admitted

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both possessed and confessed, as in owned up.

clue.text: He provides glasses for IPA and tonic cocktail

indicators.note: a cocktail is a mixture, so these letters are mixed together

explanation.surface: A bartender pours a mixed drink of beer and tonic water into glasses.
explanation.walkthrough: IPA is India pale ale; 'cocktail' mixes its letters with TONIC.
explanation.definitionFit: An eye specialist prescribes and supplies spectacles.

clue.text: One of the family is in Majorca until Sunday

indicators.note: the answer is contained within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A relative is staying in Majorca until the weekend.
explanation.definitionFit: A parent's sister is a relative.

clue.text: Symbolic signs are to be set up in the country

indicators.note: the turned word goes inside the word for country

parts.note: a nation is a country

indicators.note: in a down clue set up means read upwards, so backwards

explanation.surface: Road signs are to be erected across the land.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'be set up' reads the little word upwards; 'in' then places it within the country.
explanation.definitionFit: A system of written symbols, as in musical or chess script.

clue.text: Where car travellers take their luggage as well

definitions.text: Where car travellers take their luggage
definitions.meaning: read literally, into the rear storage space of a car

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means besides, and literally names the car's rear compartment as a destination.

clue.text: Suspicious about grandiloquent language in covenant

indicators.note: about means one word goes round the other

parts.note: wary means suspicious, on guard
a rant is a bombastic, high-flown speech

explanation.surface: Someone is wary of bombastic wording in a contract.
explanation.definitionFit: A written guarantee or binding promise, as in a contract clause.

clue.text: Model once again needs rest

parts.note: re as a prefix means again
to model is to pose

explanation.surface: A model posing for another session needs a break.
explanation.definitionFit: Repose means rest or tranquil calm.

clue.text: Arrive with a harvester, only to meet disaster

parts.note: to come is to arrive
a cropper is one who gathers crops

explanation.surface: Someone turns up with a reaper and things go badly wrong.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to fall heavily or fail badly.

clue.text: Servant I discovered in wild embrace

indicators.note: the word for wild wraps round the single letter

parts.note: mad means wild or frenzied

explanation.surface: A housemaid is found in a passionate clinch.
explanation.definitionFit: A female domestic worker.

clue.text: Nothing is written on some French poems

parts.note: O, the figure zero, is nothing
des is French for some

explanation.surface: A blank page faces a few French verses.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'is written on' puts O above DES.
explanation.definitionFit: Lyric poems addressed to a subject.

clue.text: His Latin love verse I had briefly rephrased

definitions.text: His Latin love verse I had briefly rephrased

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, O
I'd is the short form of I had

explanation.surface: Someone recalls paraphrasing a Roman poet's amorous verse.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes the Roman poet of the Amores and Ars Amatoria.
explanation.definitionFit: The Roman poet Publius Ovidius Naso wrote Latin erotic elegies.

clue.text: Government leader in Arab state made to quit home

indicators.note: the initial goes inside the word for an Arab state

parts.note: an emirate is a state ruled by an emir

indicators.note: a leader comes first, so take the opening letter

explanation.surface: A government chief in a Gulf state is forced into exile.
explanation.definitionFit: To emigrate is to leave one's country to settle elsewhere.

clue.text: Financial outlay leaves son still undecided

parts.note: a matter pending is awaiting decision

explanation.surface: A family's budget leaves their son's fate unresolved.
explanation.definitionFit: Expenditure is money paid out.
